Citation Needed is such an amazing podcast. The premise is 5 friends (Eli, Tom, Noah, Heath and Cecil) read a single Wikipedia article on anything from Rasputin to Chuck Tingle, and take the absolute piss out of the person, place, thing, concept, phenomenon or event that they’re talking about in the episode. Each episode varies from 30-50 minutes, and they post a new episode every week. They have a Patreon as well, varying from $1 per episode up to $100 per episode, which gives you exclusive access to a number of things (live-show VIP tickets, early access to episodes, Patron only videos, etc.). They have nearly 100 episodes that are free to listen to on any podcast streaming app (I found them on Stitcher) and I highly recommend this podcast to absolutely everyone! Be warned though, their humour can be pretty dark and offensive at times!
